create.name: Walt Opie
create.bio:
Walt Opie teaches in the Insight Meditation tradition and is on the core faculty of Sacramento Insight Meditation in California. He first met insight practice in 1993 and has sat residential retreats since 2005. He trained in Spirit Rock's Community Dharma Leaders programme under the mentorship of Kevin Griffin and completed the four-year IMS teacher training in 2021. Early Buddhist texts shape much of his teaching, and he names Bhikkhu Anālayo, Sayadaw U Tejaniya, Joseph Goldstein and Gil Fronsdal among the teachers who have influenced him most; he has also helped facilitate Anālayo's courses at the Barre Center for Buddhist Studies.

He gives evening talks, daylongs and retreats around the United States, including at IMS, where he is one of the teachers of a 2027 retreat on the core teachings of the Buddha for newcomers and returning students. Much of his service has been with people on the margins: he has taught meditation as a volunteer in California prisons, trained as a Buddhist chaplain through the Sati Center, and chairs the board of the Buddhist Recovery Network. A former communications staffer at Spirit Rock with an MFA in writing, he has published essays and poetry in Buddhist journals. He grew up in Virginia and lives in Berkeley with his family.

courses.title: Living Dharma Livestream Retreat 2027
courses.description: The online version of a five-night IMS retreat on the Buddha's essential teachings, led with bruni dávila and Tuere Sala and streamed from the Barre meditation hall. Sitting and walking periods alternate with talks on mindfulness, the Four Noble Truths, the hindrances, the three characteristics and the brahmaviharas. Suited to newcomers as well as experienced meditators.

courses.title: Sit & Dharma Talk with Walt Opie (Sacramento Insight Meditation)
courses.description: An evening of sitting meditation and a dharma talk that Walt gives in person at the Sacramento Dharma Center, also open on Zoom. Offered on a donation basis, with most of the dana going to the teacher.

free_resources.title: Walt Opie's Dharma Talks on Dharma Seed
free_resources.description: An archive of his recorded talks and guided sessions, free to stream or download, including talks on feeling tone, perception and the IMS Daily Dharma series.

flags: Health rule, borderline teacher: a large share of his work is Buddhist addiction recovery (Board President of the Buddhist Recovery Network, co-leads the IMS Insight Recovery Sangha, recovery daylong at IMS, BRN Academy talks). Kept because his YouTube and teaching as a whole are mainly general insight dharma (IMS Daily Dharma, Insight Meditation Center, Gay Buddhist Fellowship, Sacramento Insight core faculty, the 2027 IMS Living Dharma retreat); all recovery items left out. Owner may prefer to skip.
Email: his Contact page has a mailto link (walt@buddhistpathways.org) with no visible text, so it is not treated as published; the contact form is used instead.
Availability local_online with Sacramento as base: he is core faculty at Sacramento Insight Meditation (hybrid evenings) but lives in Berkeley, CA.

No YouTube channel of his own; all videos are talks on other channels (IMS, Insight Meditation Center, Gay Buddhist Fellowship, Kevin Griffin, A Positive Light) where he is the main speaker. Some carry dates in their titles (copied as they are).
The Dharma Seed archive also includes his recovery talks (12 Steps class series, Dharma & Recovery); the resource description mentions only the general talks.
The Sacramento sit is a single dated evening (12 Nov 2026); he teaches there regularly but the SIM calendar lists each evening separately.
